newsitem.title: INDIA: India HZL tenders for lead concentrate imports.
newsitem.headline: India HZL tenders for lead concentrate imports.

text.p: India's Hindustan Zinc Ltd (HZL) tendered on Friday to import 25,000 tonnes of lead concentrates annually over the next five years.
The state-run company said in a notice published in the Financial Express newspaper that it was seeking a long-term contract, initially for five years.

"HCL intends to enter into long-term contract with actual producers having their own captive mines/beneficiation plant and/or accredited traders...for purchase of about 25,000 tonnes lead concentrates, in suitable parcels, annually for an initial period of five years," the notice said.
It said the period of the contract could be extended for another five years on mutual agreement.
Tender offers should be submitted by March 26, it said.
